To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of prior payment behavior variables in SE default prediction modelling is a promising approach which is particularly effective in the case of long-term default prediction and/or for small SEs.
the inclusion of prior payment behavior variables in SE default prediction models is beneficial for both small and medium size enterprises, while it is not for large enterprises.

“Using prior payment behavior variables for SE default prediction significantly improves model accuracy and should be considered in order to obtain more accurate default models, especially when the size of the SEs to be analyzed is small and the forecasting horizon is long”.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of prior payment behavior variables to enhance the accuracy of SE default prediction models.
the use of payment behavior variables for SE default prediction, and it is based on a large and representative database of Italian SEs.
the development of an innovative approach for the default prediction modelling of SEs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the more the SEs that are the object of the analysis are small in size, the longer the default prediction horizon, and/or the less the financial information available, the more the use of prior payment behavior variables is likely to improve the accuracy of the SE default prediction models.
the more accurate the default prediction model and the more relevant its application field (e.g. in terms of size of the firms to be analysed)

, in order to achieve the best possible accuracy, the most effective approach for SE default prediction would be to use a model which is based on both financial ratios and prior payment behavior variables.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of payment behavior related variables in default prediction modelling for SEs is strongly recommended, especially when the forecast horizon is long and/or the size of the SEs under analysis is small.
the use of prior payment behavior variables is a useful way for improving the effectiveness of SEs default prediction models.
the use of prior payment behavior variables in default prediction modelling is a promising research area, which should be further explored by researchers in the field.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the purpose of SE default prediction, payment behavior related variables should be included in the default prediction modelling process, especially for small SEs.
the effectiveness of financial ratios for SEs default prediction modelling can be improved by using also prior firm payment behavior variables.
SEs’ payment behavior should be taken into account when building default prediction models.
